title: AI Life Admin OS: Household Binder Spreadsheet, Renewal and Warranty Tracker, Important Documents Index, Excel and Google Sheets
description:
Every renewal, warranty and "where did I put it" in one place. AI Life Admin OS is a household binder that works out its own dates, for Excel and Google Sheets.

What it does for you:
• Renewals and deadlines: insurance, phone, licences, memberships, each with an act-by date and a plain flag
• Sunday Reset: 15 minutes, 5 steps, and a "coming up" list that builds itself from your tabs
• Warranties: bought date plus months of cover gives the end date, with a nudge 60 days before
• Where It's Kept: where every important paper lives and who can get to it
• Privacy check: type 5 or more digits or the word "password" and it asks you to remove it
• Year View: your next 12 months of renewals on one chart, plus the yearly total
• Ask AI: 3 prompts built from your list (names and dates, never numbers) for the AI chat you already use

What's in the download:
• 2 spreadsheets: a Sample file with a made-up household and a Blank file for yours
• A 3-page PDF: quick start, a printable Sunday Reset card and a paper index for your binder

Good to know:
• Works in Microsoft 365, Excel 2019 or newer and Google Sheets
• Any currency: $, €, £, ₹ or your own symbol
• No logins and no bank connection: you type, it works out the dates
• It never needs an ID number, account number or password
• It doesn't renew, cancel or contact anyone for you
• Made with AI assistance, then built and checked by hand
• Digital download, nothing ships

From Hourback, a Steadfold studio.
